headline: Planet IC, a Schwerin hosting firm, says intruders reached its data centre servers; city websites and Wemag's customer portals went offline.
summary: New incident page. Planet IC's own notice (s001): unauthorised access to servers in its data centre on the evening of Nov 21; forensic experts and the state criminal police involved; the state data protection commissioner and the BSI informed; systems coming back step by step. dpa (s006) quotes Planet IC's email: servers and services taken offline and hosted websites with them; no word on data. Wemag's release (s003, Nov 25): customer portals of Wemag and Wemacom offline, attackers potentially had access to customer data, authorities told, power and phone unaffected. Security-Insider (s008) reports, citing NDR, that Wemag customer data got out (Reported). Börsen-Zeitung (s007): NRW.BANK took its site offline and says it has no sign of data theft. Main answer Confirmed, filed under hack-stated, on Planet IC's own notice carried by dpa and Börsen-Zeitung. incident_type attack; service partly-back: at the Nov 27 evening check Schwerin's site showed a temporary page, Greifswald's was limited, Wemag's portal was down and NRW.BANK's site was limited, while Wemag's main site worked (s004, s005, s010 to s012). Size Regional. Supplier question answered from the affected organisations' own words and outlets: Wemag, NRW.BANK, three cities and five other local bodies. Waren an der Müritz's site did not respond. Picture: Wikimedia Commons photograph of Wemag's Schwerin office (CC BY 4.0). Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread on Planet IC, Wemag or Schwerin in the last seven days; Reddit not reachable. Privacy check done: no private people named.
author: Research agent
